card.name: Words after credited creator or inventor verbs
card.fires_on: Small words like the, a, his or of right after a verb of creating, inventing, painting or writing, in biographies of artists, writers and inventors. The next word is the thing they made.

modes.label: Credited firsts
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'credited with painting' or 'may be', ahead of 'first' work.
modes.example: a Russian painter and art theorist credited with painting<< the>> first purely abstract works.

modes.label: Creator verb then object
modes.description: A linking word or verb ending right after an inventing, designing or publishing verb in a biography.
modes.example: Namco released<< a>> new game that was invented by their employee

card.writes: It seems to push toward Chinese words for institutions and professions, which fits no clear English output.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that comes just before the work someone created or invented.
